scenes.say: Scammers plant fake bank helplines on Google, and people call them. [[0.3]] Helpline Watch finds them first.

card.title: Fake helplines, found before the call.

scenes.say: By March 2026, India had logged one point seven three lakh complaints, and over twenty-one hundred crore rupees lost, to fake customer-care numbers found on Google. [[0.4]] The fraud team googles from one desk, and never sees what a victim in Patna is shown.

card.label: lost in India to fake customer-care numbers found on Google
card.sub: 1.73 lakh complaints. The analyst searches from one desk and never sees the victim's page.

scenes.say: Helpline Watch searches Google the way victims do, from every Indian city you choose, then marks every number that is not the brand's. [[0.3]] Let's sweep HDFC Bank.

Twenty-two searches from five cities: results, the answer box, People also ask, the local pack, Maps, and ads, each one made through SerpApi's location parameter. [[0.4]] Three fakes. And here's the first: a mobile number sitting in a Maps listing named HDFC Bank Customer Care Number.

Every verdict explains itself. [[0.3]] Seven named signals: a mobile posing as a regulated bank's helpline, a listing named like no bank names its branches, planted in three cities, and complaints found when we search the number itself. No language model anywhere in the verdict.
The same number is posing as HDFC Bank, Zomato and IndiGo at once. [[0.3]] That's one operation, not three coincidences. And the Ads Transparency data shows who is bidding on the brand name.

It doesn't cry wolf. [[0.3]] On Kolkata's page, the official number republished by an aggregator gets a green tick. And an unknown landline from a newspaper is marked check, never filed. Numbers on the bank's own site are flagged for the list, not for takedown.

The output is the takedown pack: a CSV, the evidence with a replayable SerpApi link for every sighting, a report with the right Google form per surface, and a complaint template for the cybercrime portal. [[0.3]] A person keeps or removes every number before it goes in.

Under the hood, SerpApi's Autocomplete plans the queries victims type. Search, Maps and the Ads Transparency Center return each city's page. Deterministic signals score every number. And the pack is built only from what the analyst keeps.
